focus.title: Hitting elbow at drop
focus.why: **Bend the elbow** and lead with it. Racket head down, elbow up, arm coiled.

drill.name: Overhead throws
drill.how: Throw an old ball high and far, so it peaks well above net height. The throw puts the elbow where it belongs.

fundamentals.label: Toss
fundamentals.blurb: Everything downstream is built on where the ball goes.
fundamentals.headline: Your toss holds up. Leave it alone.

metrics.label: Release height
metrics.insight: You let go **at head height or higher**, so the ball has a short, steady climb.
metrics.softness: Your camera moved during the serve, so heights here are a guess. Stand the phone on something solid.

metrics.label: Tossing arm timing
metrics.insight: You **hold** the tossing arm up into the swing, so the chest stays open.

drill.name: Fence toss
drill.how: Stand side-on a racket from a fence and toss so the ball brushes past it, landing on one spot.

fundamentals.label: Loading
fundamentals.blurb: Legs, hips and shoulders storing energy before they unwind.
fundamentals.headline: Solid loading. Next to work on: knee bend at trophy.

metrics.label: Knee bend at trophy
metrics.insight: An **athletic load**: deep enough to store power, shallow enough to launch.

metrics.label: Shoulder tilt
metrics.insight: Hitting shoulder **down**, tossing shoulder up. That tilt sends the racket up at the ball.

metrics.label: Leg drive
metrics.insight: You **straighten up** out of the load, and the legs feed the swing.
metrics.softness: Your camera moved during the serve, so heights here are a guess. Stand the phone on something solid.

drill.name: Push throws
drill.how: From side-on with your knees bent, push a ball up and out to full reach, legs and hips first.

fundamentals.label: Swing
fundamentals.blurb: The racket drop and the acceleration that follows it.
fundamentals.headline: Your arm stays **straight** through the drop, so the racket circles round your side instead of falling behind your back.

metrics.label: Racket drop
metrics.insight: The racket **lays back behind you** before it fires, and that fall is where racket speed comes from.
metrics.softness: Your camera moved during the serve, so heights here are a guess. Stand the phone on something solid.

metrics.label: Hitting elbow at drop
metrics.insight: Your arm stays **straight** through the drop, so the racket circles round your side instead of falling behind your back.
metrics.fix: **Bend the elbow** and lead with it. Racket head down, elbow up, arm coiled.

drill.name: Overhead throws
drill.how: Throw an old ball high and far, so it peaks well above net height. The throw puts the elbow where it belongs.

metrics.label: Drop to contact
metrics.insight: Your racket **crawls** from drop to ball, so you are guiding the swing.
metrics.fix: **Stop steering**. Serve at easy pace but twice as loose, and extend late.

drill.name: Loose arm serve
drill.how: Serve at easy intent with a light grip and let the arm extend late.

metrics.label: Hand under the elbow
metrics.readout: Hand never gets under the elbow
metrics.insight: Your hand **never gets under your elbow**, so the arm pushes the ball instead of throwing it.
metrics.fix: **Let the hand hang under your elbow** as the arm goes up. Keep the grip loose.

drill.name: Ball in a sock
drill.how: Swing a ball in a sock, or a towel, through the whole motion without stopping.

drill.name: Let the racket fall
drill.how: Serve at half pace with one thought: let the racket fall down your back before anything else moves.

fundamentals.label: Contact
fundamentals.blurb: Where you meet the ball, and how much of you is behind it.
fundamentals.headline: Solid contact. Next to work on: arm extension at contact.

metrics.label: Hand height at contact
metrics.insight: You strike at **full stretch**, exactly where your margin over the net lives.
metrics.softness: Your camera moved during the serve, so heights here are a guess. Stand the phone on something solid.

metrics.label: Arm extension at contact
metrics.insight: **Long arm** at contact, with nothing left on the table.

readings.label: Body extension
readings.softness: Your camera moved during the serve, so heights here are a guess. Stand the phone on something solid.

drill.name: Hit up and out
drill.how: From the service line, swing up and out towards the back fence and let the racket bring the ball down.

fundamentals.label: Rhythm
fundamentals.blurb: Where each piece lands against the others.
fundamentals.headline: Your rhythm holds up. Leave it alone.

metrics.label: Time from trophy to contact
metrics.insight: A **clean split** between the slow build and the fast finish.

readings.label: Arms in sync
readings.softness: Your camera moved during the serve, so heights here are a guess. Stand the phone on something solid.

drill.name: Count the serve
drill.how: Say one as both hands go down, two at the trophy, three at contact. One and two stay slow.
